description: Certificate and domain-registration expiry for 2 to 5 domains in one call: days left, expiry dates and an ok/warn/expired status per domain, plus the soonest date overall. Certificate dates come from CT logs, registration dates from RDAP. Partial results if some lookups fail; if every domain fails it returns an error and is not charged. Costs $0.04 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
name: expiry_batch
